title: Beach Cleanup Rally
desc: Join us to remove coastal litter and restore the shoreline and ocean.
body: We’ll meet at the main beach entrance at 8:00 AM. Gloves, bags, and a quick safety briefing will be provided. All ages welcome. Bring sunscreen, water, and your enthusiasm.

title: Community Recycling Challenge
desc: 28-day recycling challenge with points, prizes, and impact badges.
body: Sign up as an individual or household. Track recycling activity through the challenge portal. Top scorers win prizes and community recognition.

title: Home Composting Workshop
desc: Learn to compost at home, reduce food scraps, and enrich your garden.
location: Irvine Community Center, 1 Community Dr, Irvine, CA 92612
body: A hands-on workshop covering bin setup, compost layering, and troubleshooting. Take home a starter kit. $10 registration covers materials.

title: E-Waste Recycling Day
desc: Free drop-off for devices and batteries, plus secure data wipe guidance.
location: City Hall Parking Lot, 4445 Civic Center Dr, Irvine, CA 92602
body: Bring old computers, phones, batteries, and cables. On-site data wipe guidance for drives and phones. Free for residents and small business.

title: Campus Sustainability Talk
desc: Environmental educators share real circular economy projects in schools.
location: UCI Student Center, 501 Aldrich Hall, Irvine, CA 92697
body: Doors open at 6:00 PM. Speakers from local schools and nonprofits will present classroom projects and circular economy case studies. Free parking after 5 PM.

title: Weekend Tote Bag DIY
desc: Upcycle fabric into a custom tote bag to cut single-use plastic.
location: RecycleBin Creative Studio, 100 Main St, Irvine, CA 92618
body: Bring an old shirt or fabric scrap. We provide sewing kits and stencils. All skill levels welcome. Completed bags can be taken home the same day.
